blocks.text: “Pinoy Big Brother” has officially unveiled the new facade of Bahay ni Kuya ahead of the upcoming “Collab 3.0.” ABS-CBN Corporation chief operating officer for broadcast Cory Vidanes and GMA Network Inc. senior vice president Atty. Annette Gozon-Valdes led the unveiling on Tuesday, October 20. The reveal was livestream on the program’s official Facebook page where Robi Domingo and Alexa Ilacad served as hosts. The new house is located in the former Gina Lopez Building, which previously housed employees of the ABS-CBN Foundation.
